ns0:section.ns0:heading: Applicability to conduct outside the United States
ns0:section.ns0:chapeau: This chapter also applies to conduct occurring outside the United States if—

ns0:paragraph.ns0:content: the offender is a natural person who is a citizen or permanent resident alien of the United States, or an organization organized under the laws of the United States or a State or political subdivision thereof; or
an act in furtherance of the offense was committed in the United States.
